newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly higher.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate inched up to 8.291 percent from Tuesday's 8.216 percent close, with commercial paper stable at 8.00 percent, dealers said.
The central bank injected T$5 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations, helping ease tight market liquidity, they said.
With continued fund injection by the central bank, dealers said they expected the money rates to come down a little on Thursday.

Dealers said trading interest thickened as investors shifted their focus from the local stock exchange, where profit-taking after strong recent gains sent share prices tumbling 1.99 percent on Wednesday in heavy trade.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1000-1020 percent against Tuesday's 6.1060-1075.
